name: midi-website-backend
description: Backend API for Mineral Industry Development Institute (MIDI) Portal

scripts.db:reset:seed: sequelize-cli db:migrate:undo:all && sequelize-cli db:migrate && sequelize-cli db:seed:all
scripts.db:fresh: sequelize-cli db:drop && sequelize-cli db:create && sequelize-cli db:migrate && sequelize-cli db:seed:all
scripts.db:dump: docker exec jarra_postgres pg_dump -U postgres -d jarra_website -f /tmp/init_data.sql && docker cp jarra_postgres:/tmp/init_data.sql ./init_data.sql
scripts.db:restore: docker cp ./init_data.sql jarra_postgres_prod:/tmp/init_data.sql && docker exec jarra_postgres_prod psql -U postgres -d jarra_website -f /tmp/init_data.sql
